modelingNotes: Actual global OSM way/28824850 (Q1107297) supplies the base outline and original height64m/ele89 tags. Five actual mapped parts supply the shaft outline at50m, low gallery roof5m, north entrance10m, central base12m and entrance surround8m. The exported overall height stays64m; ele89 is not added to geometry height.

SF Recreation & Parks city brochure https://sfrecpark.org/DocumentCenter/View/7387/CoitTowerBrochure_V5?bidId= describes total212ft=64.6176m and18in=.4572m reduction in shaft diameter. The64m OSM value is retained within the published rounding discrepancy; the brochure taper is authored as .2286m radius reduction.

SF Planning official National Register nomination https://commissions.sfplanning.org/hpcpackets/2017-015688FED.pdf section7 pages5-6 confirms eight high belvedere arches, open circular lantern, the north entry flanked by two fluted columns, three glazed sides with four ornamental columns each, pivot round windows and the phoenix/fasces relief. Its included2008 description explicitly gives24 vertical flutes. The182ft description and180ft rising-from-base description are documented alongside the212ft brochure, rather than silently altering source tags.

Individually inspected eligible Commons front photographs by Edward Z. Yang and Christoph Radtke, PerryPlanet distant view and cropped front by dfaulder identify this tower. They show the shallow concave shaft flutes, eight deep upper arches, three small openings above each big arch, higher round-headed crown openings, inset round windows and small balustrades. Images are visual references only, never textures.

Photo-guided inference: the50-58.3m belvedere,59-60.3m triplets and61-63.5m crown openings; wall thickness.65m, inset machine core radius3.15m, reduced small balusters, course seams, window divisions and abstract phoenix relief. The upper gallery and lantern openings are actual air, not dark panels. Lower doors/windows and inset pivot windows use the supported library window finish.

Both LODs retain24 flutes, all eight main arches and upper crown openings, source-registered north entrance and the glazed base. Low omits small triplet perforations, course seams and individual relief/rail detail, retaining the principal architecture. No landscape trees, murals, flag fabric or surrounding road/plaza are included.
